attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Occupational Therapy (Department of Health, Division of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Presentations, clinical instruction, publications, research, in-service programs, AOTA or AOTA-approved-provider activities and others. Category I formal programs (university courses, workshops, in-service, institutes; 1 h per hour); Category II symposia, colloquia, journal clubs, self-study (1 h per hour or 1 CAU per hour); Category III presentations incl. clinical instruction (2 h for 1 h taught, 4 for 2, 5 for 3; max 5); Category IV publications (book 10, juried article 8, chapter 5, national non-juried article 4).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed during the 2-year period before renewal: hours prorated by time licensed.
rules.audit_note: Proof of participation is shown on renewal; licensees keep documentation (course descriptions, attendance proof) at least 4 years. Board may grant extensions, variances or waivers for hardship.
rules.notes: Biennial licenses expire March 31 of even-numbered years; renewal applications go out by March 1 of each even year.
